text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Crazy. Was the Droit always such a huge
event?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No! This year was the biggest it's ever
been! And I think our dance
had
something to do with that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You really think so? Hold on, are you sure
it's okay for the
ever-popular Fuji to be
out here right now?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If I remember right, you've got a closing
speech to give. You've got it
rough, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I thought I'd get some air before that.
And
I hope you realize you're
just as popular.
All your friends were looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather avoid being made fun of...
But if
you came to give your
thanks, I'm all ears.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I knew you were sharp. You still
don't have a grasp on how I
really feel
though.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Sky... for being my date.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't mistaken about you. You were the
ultimate trickster. The
cheers were proof
of that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Our dance became a wonderful memory
for everyone there. Hehe,
thank you so
much. I'm sorry I wouldn't take no for an
answer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No need to apologize. I'm the one who
accepted your deal. And you
probably...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, you got to know all about Shakur's
peculiar skills and all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I really need to thank her as well. I
have a feeling I'll be
organizing quite a
few scrimmages starting next week.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Oh,
I bet my adorable ponies are starting
to worry. I should head
back.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. There was something I wanted
to tell you too.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Lend me your ear...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: U-uh?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Your dress... looks beautiful on you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I had trouble telling you because... you
really do resemble a goddess.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Fooled you good! ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Another big surprise in the bag. Phew, I
really wanted to get even after you sucked
me into all this, so I went with the cool,
suave
approach. ☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
With that said, isn't it about time? Good
luck with your speech. See
ya! ☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...What a shock. Hehe, you didn't need to
do that if you're going to
get embarrassed
about it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(But it seems like she's really feeling
better. I'm glad.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Being the leader of another dorm, I was
afraid of stepping in too
much. But I
couldn't help it seeing the state she was
in.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All right. It wasn't a real date,
but I got my
compliment. Nothing left
but to give a
spectacular speech.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've announced this evening's
best couple, it's time to
close out the
night!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone. Did you all enjoy this
year's Ligne Droite? For some
of you, it
was your first time...  For others, it was
perhaps your last.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
All of us, though, will always be striving
forward. And wherever we may go, every
day we'll be running until both our bodies
and our
hearts are worn out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's what we chose, and we'll never stop
chasing after our dreams.
But the next time
you think you can't take another step...
remember this night.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You, the runner next to you... You're all
running down your own paths in life.
Remember that each and every one of you
is beautiful... and the star of your own
story.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Only you can run down that final stretch.
So follow your heart, dash
ahead... and
cross the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...
I'm just not the right match for
Fuji. I can't... match that
beauty.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'll get you back for making me dance to
your tune... my dear date.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I sense a big hassle approaching. But
since I'm so close to
thinking up a new
racing strategy, I guess I'll have to...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Run away! ♪
